# FinOps -- Budget Alerts and Cost Control in Terraform

**Version**: 1.0
**Date**: 2026-03-18
**Applies to**: All infrastructure generated by the infrastructure generator
**Source**: FinOps Foundation, Azure WAF Cost Optimization Pillar

---

> Every stack generates a `finops.tf` file. Cost control is not an afterthought --
> it is a first-class concern built into every deployment. Budget alerts, auto-shutdown,
> storage lifecycle, and right-sizing are implemented in Terraform, not in a spreadsheet.

## 1. Budget Alerts

### Why Budget Alerts Are Mandatory

Every Terraform stack includes a budget alert on the resource group. Without budget
alerts, a misconfigured auto-scaler, a forgotten dev environment, or a compromised
credential can generate thousands of euros in charges before anyone notices.

Budget alerts cost nothing -- they only send notifications.

### Implementation

```hcl
# finops.tf
resource "azurerm_consumption_budget_resource_group" "main" {
  name              = "budget-${local.name_prefix}"
  resource_group_id = module.resource_group.resource_id

  amount     = var.monthly_budget
  time_grain = "Monthly"

  time_period {
    start_date = formatdate("YYYY-MM-01'T'00:00:00Z", timestamp())
  }

  # Alert at 50% actual spend
  notification {
    enabled        = true
    threshold      = 50
    operator       = "GreaterThanOrEqualTo"
    threshold_type = "Actual"
    contact_emails = var.alert_emails
  }

  # Alert at 80% actual spend
  notification {
    enabled        = true
    threshold      = 80
    operator       = "GreaterThanOrEqualTo"
    threshold_type = "Actual"
    contact_emails = var.alert_emails
  }

  # Alert when forecast exceeds 100%
  notification {
    enabled        = true
    threshold      = 100
    operator       = "GreaterThanOrEqualTo"
    threshold_type = "Forecasted"
    contact_emails = var.alert_emails
  }

  # Alert at 120% actual spend (overspend)
  notification {
    enabled        = true
    threshold      = 120
    operator       = "GreaterThanOrEqualTo"
    threshold_type = "Actual"
    contact_emails = var.alert_emails
  }

  lifecycle {
    ignore_changes = [time_period]
  }
}
```

### Budget Variables

```hcl
# variables.tf
variable "monthly_budget" {
  description = "Monthly budget in EUR for cost alerts"
  type        = number
  default     = 500

  validation {
    condition     = var.monthly_budget > 0
    error_message = "Monthly budget must be a positive number."
  }
}

variable "alert_emails" {
  description = "Email addresses for budget and operational alerts"
  type        = list(string)
  default     = []

  validation {
    condition     = length(var.alert_emails) > 0
    error_message = "At least one alert email must be provided."
  }
}
```

### Recommended Budget by Tier

| Tier | Typical Monthly Cost | Suggested Budget | Alert Thresholds |
|------|---------------------|-----------------|-----------------|
| Basic (dev) | EUR 50-200 | EUR 300 | 50%, 80%, 100% forecast, 120% |
| Standard (prod) | EUR 200-1,500 | EUR 2,000 | 50%, 80%, 100% forecast, 120% |
| Premium (regulated) | EUR 1,500-10,000 | EUR 12,000 | 50%, 80%, 100% forecast, 120% |

## 2. Auto-Shutdown for Dev VMs

### Why Auto-Shutdown Matters

A Standard_D4s_v5 VM in West Europe costs approximately EUR 140/month running 24/7.
With auto-shutdown at 19:00 on weekdays (and off on weekends), the cost drops to
approximately EUR 40/month -- a 70% reduction.

Auto-shutdown is enabled by default for dev/test environments.

### Implementation

```hcl
# finops.tf
resource "azurerm_dev_test_global_vm_shutdown_schedule" "vm" {
  count = var.environment == "dev" || var.environment == "test" ? 1 : 0

  virtual_machine_id    = module.vm.resource_id
  location              = var.location
  enabled               = true
  daily_recurrence_time = var.auto_shutdown_time
  timezone              = var.auto_shutdown_timezone

  notification_settings {
    enabled         = true
    email           = join(",", var.alert_emails)
    time_in_minutes = 30
    webhook_url     = ""
  }

  tags = local.common_tags
}
```

### Auto-Shutdown Variables

```hcl
# variables.tf
variable "auto_shutdown_time" {
  description = "Daily auto-shutdown time in HHmm format (24h)"
  type        = string
  default     = "1900"

  validation {
    condition     = can(regex("^[0-2][0-9][0-5][0-9]$", var.auto_shutdown_time))
    error_message = "Auto-shutdown time must be in HHmm format (e.g., 1900)."
  }
}

variable "auto_shutdown_timezone" {
  description = "Timezone for auto-shutdown schedule"
  type        = string
  default     = "Romance Standard Time"
}
```

### Auto-Shutdown Savings Estimates

| VM Size | 24/7 Monthly | With Auto-Shutdown (12h weekdays) | Savings |
|---------|-------------|-----------------------------------|---------|
| Standard_B2s | ~EUR 35 | ~EUR 10 | 71% |
| Standard_D2s_v5 | ~EUR 70 | ~EUR 20 | 71% |
| Standard_D4s_v5 | ~EUR 140 | ~EUR 40 | 71% |
| Standard_D8s_v5 | ~EUR 280 | ~EUR 80 | 71% |
| Standard_E4s_v5 | ~EUR 200 | ~EUR 57 | 71% |

> **Note**: These are Pay-As-You-Go estimates for West Europe. Actual costs depend
> on region, licensing (AHUB), and negotiated EA/CSP rates.

## 3. Storage Lifecycle Policies

### Why Lifecycle Policies Matter

Storage costs accumulate silently. A storage account with 1 TB of hot blobs costs
approximately EUR 20/month. Moving old data to Cool tier saves 50%, and Archive
tier saves 90%.

### Implementation

```hcl
# finops.tf
resource "azurerm_storage_management_policy" "lifecycle" {
  count = var.enable_storage_lifecycle ? 1 : 0

  storage_account_id = module.storage.resource_id

  rule {
    name    = "move-to-cool"
    enabled = true

    filters {
      blob_types   = ["blockBlob"]
      prefix_match = ["logs/", "backups/", "archives/"]
    }

    actions {
      base_blob {
        tier_to_cool_after_days_since_modification_greater_than    = 30
        tier_to_archive_after_days_since_modification_greater_than = 90
        delete_after_days_since_modification_greater_than          = 365
      }
      snapshot {
        delete_after_days_since_creation_greater_than = 90
      }
      version {
        delete_after_days_since_creation = 90
      }
    }
  }

  rule {
    name    = "cleanup-temp"
    enabled = true

    filters {
      blob_types   = ["blockBlob"]
      prefix_match = ["tmp/", "temp/"]
    }

    actions {
      base_blob {
        delete_after_days_since_modification_greater_than = 7
      }
    }
  }
}
```

### Lifecycle Policy Variable

```hcl
# variables.tf
variable "enable_storage_lifecycle" {
  description = "Enable storage lifecycle management for cost optimization"
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}
```

### Storage Tier Cost Comparison (West Europe, per TB/month)

| Access Tier | Cost / TB / month | Read Cost (per 10K ops) | Write Cost (per 10K ops) | Best For |
|-------------|-------------------|------------------------|--------------------------|----------|
| Hot | ~EUR 20 | EUR 0.004 | EUR 0.05 | Frequently accessed data |
| Cool | ~EUR 10 | EUR 0.01 | EUR 0.10 | Infrequently accessed (>30 days) |
| Cold | ~EUR 4.50 | EUR 0.01 | EUR 0.18 | Rarely accessed (>90 days) |
| Archive | ~EUR 2 | EUR 5.00 | EUR 0.10 | Compliance archives (>180 days) |

> **Warning**: Archive tier has high read costs and retrieval latency (hours).
> Use it only for data you rarely need to access -- compliance archives, old backups,
> audit trails.

## 4. Reserved Instance Recommendations

Reserved Instances (RIs) cannot be purchased through Terraform -- they are a billing
commitment made in the Azure Portal or via the Azure CLI. However, the infrastructure generator documents
RI recommendations in the generated README.

### When to Consider RIs

| Condition | Recommendation |
|-----------|---------------|
| Production VM running 24/7 for > 12 months | 1-year RI (30-40% savings) |
| Production VM running 24/7 for > 36 months | 3-year RI (55-65% savings) |
| Production database (PostgreSQL, SQL) stable workload | 1-year RI |
| Dev/test workloads | NEVER -- use auto-shutdown or Spot VMs |
| Unpredictable workloads | NEVER -- stay Pay-As-You-Go |

### RI Savings Estimates

| Resource | Pay-As-You-Go | 1-Year RI | 3-Year RI | 3-Year Savings |
|----------|--------------|-----------|-----------|----------------|
| Standard_D4s_v5 (VM) | ~EUR 140/mo | ~EUR 90/mo | ~EUR 55/mo | 61% |
| Standard_E4s_v5 (VM) | ~EUR 200/mo | ~EUR 130/mo | ~EUR 75/mo | 62% |
| PostgreSQL GP 4 vCores | ~EUR 300/mo | ~EUR 195/mo | ~EUR 120/mo | 60% |
| SQL Database S3 (100 DTU) | ~EUR 120/mo | ~EUR 80/mo | ~EUR 50/mo | 58% |

### Generated README Section

The generator creates the following section in every stack README:

```markdown
## Cost Optimization Recommendations

### Reserved Instances
If this stack runs in production for more than 12 months, consider purchasing
Reserved Instances for the following resources:

| Resource | Current SKU | 1-Year RI Savings | 3-Year RI Savings |
|----------|-------------|-------------------|-------------------|
| VM | Standard_D4s_v5 | ~35% | ~60% |
| PostgreSQL | GP_Standard_D4ds_v5 | ~35% | ~60% |

Purchase RIs in the Azure Portal > Reservations.
```

## 5. Cost Estimation by Tier

### Tier Comparison: App Service + PostgreSQL Stack

| Component | Basic | Standard | Premium |
|-----------|-------|----------|---------|
| App Service Plan | B1 (~EUR 12/mo) | S1 (~EUR 65/mo) | P1v3 (~EUR 130/mo) |
| PostgreSQL | Burstable B1ms (~EUR 15/mo) | GP D2ds_v5 (~EUR 150/mo) | GP D4ds_v5 (~EUR 300/mo) |
| Key Vault | Standard (~EUR 0.03/op) | Standard (~EUR 0.03/op) | Standard (~EUR 0.03/op) |
| Storage Account | LRS (~EUR 2/mo) | ZRS (~EUR 3/mo) | GRS (~EUR 4/mo) |
| Log Analytics | 30d (~EUR 5/mo) | 90d (~EUR 15/mo) | 365d (~EUR 50/mo) |
| Private Endpoints | -- | 3 PEs (~EUR 22/mo) | 3 PEs (~EUR 22/mo) |
| Firewall | -- | -- | Standard (~EUR 900/mo) |
| Bastion | -- | -- | Basic (~EUR 140/mo) |
| Front Door | -- | -- | Standard (~EUR 250/mo) |
| Backup Vault | -- | -- | ~EUR 20/mo |
| **Total Estimate** | **~EUR 35/mo** | **~EUR 260/mo** | **~EUR 1,820/mo** |

> **Important**: These are estimates for West Europe (Pay-As-You-Go). Actual costs
> depend on data volume, transactions, bandwidth, and negotiated rates. Use the
> [Azure Pricing Calculator](https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/pricing/calculator/)
> for precise quotes.

### What Each Tier Disables

| Component | Basic | Standard | Premium |
|-----------|-------|----------|---------|
| Firewall | `count = 0` | `count = 0` | Enabled |
| Bastion | `count = 0` | `count = 0` | Enabled |
| Backup Vault | `count = 0` | `count = 0` | Enabled |
| Private Endpoints | `count = 0` | Enabled | Enabled |
| Front Door | `count = 0` | `count = 0` | Enabled |
| Public Access | Enabled | Disabled | Disabled |

## 6. Complete finops.tf Example

```hcl
# finops.tf
# =============================================================================
# FinOps — Budget Alerts, Auto-Shutdown, Storage Lifecycle
# WAF: Cost Optimization pillar
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Budget Alert
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "azurerm_consumption_budget_resource_group" "main" {
  name              = "budget-${local.name_prefix}"
  resource_group_id = module.resource_group.resource_id

  amount     = var.monthly_budget
  time_grain = "Monthly"

  time_period {
    start_date = formatdate("YYYY-MM-01'T'00:00:00Z", timestamp())
  }

  notification {
    enabled        = true
    threshold      = 50
    operator       = "GreaterThanOrEqualTo"
    threshold_type = "Actual"
    contact_emails = var.alert_emails
  }

  notification {
    enabled        = true
    threshold      = 80
    operator       = "GreaterThanOrEqualTo"
    threshold_type = "Actual"
    contact_emails = var.alert_emails
  }

  notification {
    enabled        = true
    threshold      = 100
    operator       = "GreaterThanOrEqualTo"
    threshold_type = "Forecasted"
    contact_emails = var.alert_emails
  }

  notification {
    enabled        = true
    threshold      = 120
    operator       = "GreaterThanOrEqualTo"
    threshold_type = "Actual"
    contact_emails = var.alert_emails
  }

  lifecycle {
    ignore_changes = [time_period]
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Auto-Shutdown for Dev/Test VMs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "azurerm_dev_test_global_vm_shutdown_schedule" "vm" {
  count = (
    (var.environment == "dev" || var.environment == "test") &&
    var.enable_auto_shutdown
  ) ? length(local.vm_ids) : 0

  virtual_machine_id    = local.vm_ids[count.index]
  location              = var.location
  enabled               = true
  daily_recurrence_time = var.auto_shutdown_time
  timezone              = var.auto_shutdown_timezone

  notification_settings {
    enabled         = true
    email           = join(",", var.alert_emails)
    time_in_minutes = 30
    webhook_url     = ""
  }

  tags = local.common_tags
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Storage Lifecycle Policy
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "azurerm_storage_management_policy" "lifecycle" {
  count = var.enable_storage_lifecycle ? 1 : 0

  storage_account_id = module.storage.resource_id

  rule {
    name    = "optimize-log-storage"
    enabled = true

    filters {
      blob_types   = ["blockBlob"]
      prefix_match = ["logs/", "diagnostics/"]
    }

    actions {
      base_blob {
        tier_to_cool_after_days_since_modification_greater_than    = 30
        tier_to_archive_after_days_since_modification_greater_than = 90
        delete_after_days_since_modification_greater_than          = var.log_retention_days
      }
      snapshot {
        delete_after_days_since_creation_greater_than = 30
      }
    }
  }

  rule {
    name    = "optimize-backup-storage"
    enabled = true

    filters {
      blob_types   = ["blockBlob"]
      prefix_match = ["backups/"]
    }

    actions {
      base_blob {
        tier_to_cool_after_days_since_modification_greater_than    = 14
        tier_to_archive_after_days_since_modification_greater_than = 60
        delete_after_days_since_modification_greater_than          = 365
      }
    }
  }

  rule {
    name    = "cleanup-temporary"
    enabled = true

    filters {
      blob_types   = ["blockBlob"]
      prefix_match = ["tmp/", "temp/", "staging/"]
    }

    actions {
      base_blob {
        delete_after_days_since_modification_greater_than = 7
      }
    }
  }
}
```
